input.summary: Verified the UCL Computer Science MSc 2026/27 admissions deadlines and separated programme-linked funding from university-wide funding. No single university-wide funding deadline was found on the official general funding page.

sections.title: Programme application deadline
sections.body: UCL Computer Science MSc, September 2026 entry: applicants requiring a visa had an application window of 20 October 2025–27 March 2026; the course page states applications are closed. Applicants not requiring a visa may apply until 28 August 2026 at 10:00 UK time. Because the applicant is a Nigerian citizen resident in Nigeria, the visa-required deadline is the relevant pathway unless UCL confirms otherwise. The page does not state a separate deadline timezone for the visa deadline; the non-visa closing time is explicitly 10:00 UK time. As of 8 August 2026, both the visa deadline and the programme's explicit scholarship deadline below have passed, while the non-visa admissions deadline remains future-dated but is not the expected route without confirmed visa exemption.

sections.title: Programme-linked funding
sections.body: The Computer Science MSc page lists the UCL East London Scholarship with a deadline of 25 June 2026. The dedicated official scholarship page specifies 5:00pm BST on Thursday 25 June 2026, covering tuition fees plus a £17,096 maintenance payment. It is restricted to Home fee-status applicants ordinarily resident in the UK or Ireland, with additional east-London residence/education and household-income criteria. The applicant's supplied Nigerian citizenship and Lagos residence do not establish eligibility and appear inconsistent with the published Home/UK-Ireland criterion; this should be treated as not eligible unless UCL confirms otherwise. The scholarship is not a general Computer Science MSc award.

sections.title: General UCL funding
sections.body: UCL's university-wide funding page directs postgraduate taught applicants to the UCL funding catalogue and Scholarships Finder; it does not publish one universal funding deadline. UCL separately advises students to investigate funding at least 12 months before the relevant academic year because individual scholarship deadlines vary. Therefore, no distinct general UCL funding deadline can be verified from the supplied official page. Individual awards must be checked separately by nationality, fee status, programme, and award-specific deadline.

sections.title: Important funding context
sections.body: The official course page lists 2026/27 overseas tuition fees of £42,700 for this MSc. The applicant's stated self-funding limit is £18,000, so the verified tuition shortfall is £24,700 before living costs, subject to fee-status confirmation and any award received.

sections.title: Unverified items / next check
sections.body: No separate Computer Science-specific international funding deadline was verified from the official pages supplied. The official Computer Science scholarships page points applicants to the UCL Scholarships Finder and general UCL funding site rather than publishing a single department-wide deadline. Recheck award-specific pages before any future application because deadlines and eligibility can change.

follow_ups: Confirm whether the applicant requires a UK Student visa; if yes, the 27 March 2026 programme deadline has passed.
Use the UCL Scholarships Finder to screen nationality- and fee-status-specific awards; record each award's own official deadline separately.
Confirm overseas fee status and funding plan given the £42,700 tuition fee and £18,000 self-funding ceiling.
